input: results-schema.json; semantic pair/control checks in validate() fail closed

migration_conjunction.per_task: S05 binding LOW AND not binding HIGH AND named non-S05 newly binding HIGH
migration_conjunction.per_repository: report each repository x task-class stratum; never infer from pooled average
migration_conjunction.per_task_class: report each repository x class and condition interaction
migration_conjunction.cohort: pass in >=2 repositories and >=2 task classes, no opposite interaction, manipulation succeeds, controls valid, and P1 >=15% or P2 >=0.10 with positive adjusted interval

binding: candidate_clause_met AND binding_clause_met AND ci_low > 0, separately for frozen type/stage/condition; binding evidence must be produced by the frozen queue/rework/bootstrap replay before ingestion
blocked: administrative stop, >20% common defects, identity/integrity failure, or <75% planned pairs classifiable
indeterminate: not blocked and failed manipulation, invalid/imbalanced artifacts, unclassifiable binding, overhead-sensitive call, or <80% power
domain_dependent: qualified migration in some but not other repository/class strata with frozen interaction evidence and no cohort-wide support
supported: full conjunction and frozen effect threshold; never longest-stage alone
not_supported: adequate information and no higher-precedence category, including null, opposite, proportional, or implementation-still-binding
known_boundary: The executable rehearsal uses supplied frozen binding replay evidence and descriptive time contrast. Production freeze requires the amendment's 10,000-resample cluster bootstrap/mixed model adapter before authorization.
determinism: canonical sorted JSON hashing/output; no clock, network, candidate implementation, or unseeded randomness
